title: Wooden Shield
summary: A wooden shield granting +2 AC in BG3.

fields.Armour Class: +2 while equipped, with Shield proficiency. Weighs about 6 lb. The pinned variants list no shield action.
fields.Acquisition: Paladin starting equipment, Talli’s tent at Last Light Inn, or some Grymforge duergar.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
